key_findings: Kinin B1 and B2 receptor antagonists reduced breast tumor- and aromatase inhibitor-induced mechanical allodynia in mice.
Tumor increased plantar bradykinin and B1/B2 receptor expression; antagonists did not impair paclitaxel cytotoxicity.
